summary: EchoStar subsidiary DISH DBS emerged from prepackaged Chapter 11 on October 1, 2026, after the Bankruptcy Court confirmed its standalone plan on September 29; the DISH Wireless plan was bifurcated. Per the March 19, 2026 RSA, debt restructuring plus full repayment of the 7.75% 2026 notes and partial early repayment of the 5.25% secured notes cut DISH DBS debt by roughly $4.35 billion. DISH DBS, guarantors, Wilmington Savings Fund Society as successor trustee and U.S. Bank as collateral agent executed a secured notes supplemental indenture. Watch residual DISH Wireless proceedings, EchoStar guarantees and any intercompany or collateral leakage.
